text: Yes, the property lost tree cover in 2019. Hansen data detected 1.8 ha of loss, meeting the 0.5 ha minimum event size threshold. The loss area was corroborated by JRC 2020 data, which showed the same area as forest. MGAP’s 2021 forest map identified the lost trees as planted pine species, not native forest. While Hansen also recorded 3.1 ha of sub-threshold (under 0.5 ha) loss patches in 2019, these were not counted as an event. The loss was permanent, as the later-year observation rule was satisfied.
